items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: Art Tatum. Just meeting him and learning so much from him... Because he was a guy that just loved all pianists. No matter how little you played, he always had a listening ear for you. I just stuck to Art Tatum like glue.

ctx.x: But this was, I guess, around in the late Thirties. Then around 1941 (I think it was '41, or it might have been '40, somewhere between '41 and '40), I had the extreme pleasure -- it was like a dream come true -- to meet Art Tatum. It so happens that a fellow that I mentioned before that had a band, Booker Coleman, had been friends with Art Tatum for years. He had known him since he was a very young man, so much to the extent that Art always called Booker's mother...he called her "Mama" too. And there were so many…
